stories.name: Amazon Q2 Earnings
stories.blurb: Amazon's stronger-than-expected Q2 earnings, driven by AWS growth and heavy investment, spark a stock rally and debate over whether shares remain a buy.

stories.name: Qualcomm-Amazon AI Chip Deal
stories.blurb: Qualcomm and Amazon announced a multi-generation partnership to develop custom AI data center chips, sending Qualcomm's stock sharply higher.

stories.name: Amazon ecosystem expansion
stories.blurb: A wave of companies are announcing new executive hires, certifications, and platform integrations aimed at serving brands and retailers selling across Amazon and other major marketplaces.

stories.name: Amazon delivery expansion
stories.blurb: Amazon is rapidly expanding and restructuring its delivery and logistics network, from drones and rail to contractor disputes and a fatal cargo crash.

stories.name: AI Spending Debt Fears
stories.blurb: Investors and analysts are increasingly worried that Big Tech's massive, debt-fueled spending spree on AI infrastructure could be an unsustainable bubble with hidden financial risks.

stories.name: Anthropic IPO
stories.blurb: Anthropic is preparing a massive Nasdaq IPO, with investors weighing what the listing means for backers like Amazon and Alphabet amid other Anthropic news on products and security.

rel.why: Anthropic is a major Amazon partner/customer (AWS invests in and hosts Anthropic), so its IPO bears on Amazon's AI strategy and stake value.

stories.name: Meta Muse vs Amazon
stories.blurb: Meta's new Muse AI shopping agent is integrating with Shopify, PayPal, and Shop Pay to challenge Amazon, which is moving to block the rival AI checkout tool from its platform, sparking market reaction

rel.why: Meta's Muse AI shopping agent with Shopify checkout is framed as competing against Amazon, and Amazon blocks Muse, bearing on Amazon's commerce platform.

stories.name: Amazon Qualcomm AI deal
stories.blurb: Amazon is partnering with Qualcomm on AI data-center chips, boosting Qualcomm's stock and validating its data-center pivot.

past.name: Big Tech Stock Picks
past.blurb: Investors and analysts are weighing whether to buy, sell, or hold major tech stocks like Microsoft, Amazon, and Oracle amid AI-driven market shifts.

5.text: AWS grew 36.7% with a $496B backlog, ads rose 26%, and Q2 net income hit $62.6B (including $53.4B pretax gains), while Amazon plans ~$220B capex against $25B+ AWS AI ARR. Analysts see the stock undervalued, trading below prior highs and Wall Street targets.

7.text: Amazon signed a 20-year nuclear power deal with Constellation and a $1B+ multi-year chip design licensing pact with Synopsys, becoming its lead customer. Amazon is also reportedly seeking outside investors for roughly $8 billion of Nvidia chips, leasing them back, and hiking AI chip rental prices.

11.text: Spreetail launched Brand Benchmark, a tool scoring brand performance on Amazon, and GROWNSY announced Prime Big Deal Days discounts for October 6-7, 2026. Other articles cover WeShop's US launch, a manufacturing AI book, L'Oréal's TikTok push, and various corporate news barely involving Amazon.

4.text: Amazon partnered with USPS on a same-day delivery pilot and expanded FTC Prime settlement payments to more customers, raising maximum refunds to $200. It also unveiled bulky-package shipping upgrades, signed a 20-year nuclear power deal with Constellation Energy, pledged $1 billion to data center communities, and appeared to be a Dallas tower tenant.

6.text: Alphabet spent more on AI infrastructure last quarter than its entire cash inflow, and analysts warn that Big Tech’s record AI capex faces rising debt and bubble risk. Michael Burry has shifted to long-dated AI puts and flagged Oracle’s $664B backlog, while Washington favors self-regulation; Amazon is not specifically covered.

8.text: Anthropic filed for an IPO targeting a valuation above $2 trillion despite a $42 billion net loss, with founders controlling 50.1% of votes and roughly 47% of sales flowing through Amazon and Google. Amazon, which owns 15–20%, is positioned as a major beneficiary.

9.text: Amazon blocked Meta's Muse AI shopping agent from its platform, while Muse hit 5 million downloads and drove Meta's stock up roughly 22–37%. Analysts see Amazon's block as a missed opportunity benefiting rival AI stocks.

12.text: Amazon's September 8 custom silicon deal with Qualcomm gives Qualcomm a named data center customer, with revenue starting in the December quarter and warrants tied to up to $60 billion of purchases. Synopsys announced multi-year agreements with Amazon Web Services and OpenAI at its September 30 Investor Day, lifting its stock.
